idiomatic.rationale: Data loading, routing and metadata are recognisably current-doc idiomatic, but 404 handling is a home-grown workaround for two framework features (notFound() and the built-in unmatched-route 404) that exist precisely for this.

correctness_risks.rationale: No serious races or leaks, and the cache design is careful, but 5xx-as-not-found can show wrong content during API hiccups, and the stale HomeBrowser state is a real visible bug on soft navigation that the tests don't cover.

evidence: app/lib/format.ts:1-90 — small, well-named pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor)
app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:85-260 — long but linear page, each rendering block maps to a spec section

evidence: app/app/[...slug]/page.tsx:12 — delete and rely on not-found.tsx (returns 404)
app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:91 — switch to notFound() (mechanical, four pages)
app/components/HomeBrowser.tsx:33-36 — needs useEffect/key re-sync of initial props
app/lib/api.ts:31 — distinguish 404 from 5xx/network failure and add an error boundary
review_cost.rationale: Nothing needs rework, but the 404 strategy, the stale-state bug and the error handling add up to one real round of changes before I'd approve.

findings.issue: Catch-all page renders 'Not found' with HTTP 200, overriding the root not-found.tsx which already handles unmatched URLs and returns a real 404 status.
findings.suggestion: Delete the catch-all; keep app/not-found.tsx as the single 404 surface for unmatched routes.

findings.issue: Missing resources are rendered via an inline component, so not-found pages respond 200 and not-found.tsx is dead code (same in moves, abilities, types pages).
findings.suggestion: Call notFound() from next/navigation; the existing not-found.tsx then renders with a 404 status before streaming.

findings.issue: Every non-OK response — including 5xx and rate limits — is returned as null and rendered as 'Not found'; there is no error.tsx for network failures either.
findings.suggestion: Return null only for 404, throw for other statuses, and add a root error.tsx so API failures surface as errors, not as confidently-wrong content.

findings.issue: Filter state is seeded once from initial props; soft-navigating from /?q=pika to / via the nav Link leaves the URL clean but the UI still filtered.
findings.suggestion: Re-sync state from props in a useEffect (as MovesSection.tsx:53-55 already does) or key the component on the serialized query.

findings.issue: Pagination uses raw <a href>, causing full document reloads and forfeiting prefetch in an otherwise client-transition app.
findings.suggestion: Use next/link for Previous/Next page links.

findings.issue: Raw instead of next/image; no images config documents why (runtime-configured media origin).
findings.suggestion: Either configure images.remotePatterns/unoptimized and use next/image, or leave a comment recording the deliberate choice.

findings.issue: No-store is asserted three ways in the root layout (dynamic, revalidate, fetchCache) plus per-fetch cache:'no-store' in api.ts:30, and re-declared on every page.
findings.suggestion: Pick one mechanism (per-fetch cache: 'no-store' + one segment config) and drop the rest.

findings.issue: EvolutionTree and EvolutionBranch are near-identical recursive components, one just to add a wrapper class.
findings.suggestion: Keep one recursive component and pass a className prop.

findings.issue: The first() multi-value searchParam helper is duplicated in app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:36.
findings.suggestion: Move it to lib/format.ts next to the other param helpers.

findings.issue: The type-badge link markup (className type-badge type-x + href) is re-implemented inline here and in moves/[name]/page.tsx:63 instead of reusing TypeBadge's link variant.
findings.suggestion: Reuse <TypeBadge name=... label=... link /> everywhere badges are rendered.

summary: A clean, well-structured App Router app whose data layer, component boundaries and URL-sync approach match current Next 16 guidance. The merge blockers are all in the same theme: 404/error handling hand-rolls over framework features (notFound(), built-in unmatched-route 404) and collapses API failures into 'Not found', plus one stale-client-state bug on the home page. One focused round of review fixes and this merges.
